game.label: Your decrypted PS5 dump folder of Astro Bot, with eboot.bin, sce_sys and data (or app0.zar) inside (PPSA21567, v01.019.000 or v01.007.000).

prepare.label: Converting Astro Bot for Windows from your dump

settings.label: Lighting
settings.help: Faster lighting runs smoother; ray-traced lighting looks closer to the PS5 but costs FPS.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: The window and output size. 8 GB graphics cards are best at 2560 x 1440 or lower.

settings.label: Frame rate limit
settings.help: The game is limited by the processor in heavy levels: 30 FPS gives the steadiest play. Game speed follows real time at any limit.

settings.label: VSync
settings.help: No tearing, a little more input delay. Works with frame generation too.

settings.label: Upscaling
settings.help: DLSS needs an NVIDIA RTX card. AMD FSR works on any card (FSR 4 on Radeon RX 9000, FSR 3.1 elsewhere).

settings.label: Frame generation
settings.help: NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation: RTX 40 or newer, and DLSS as the upscaler. 3x and 4x need an RTX 50 card.

settings.label: Frame generation target
settings.help: Frames shown per second with frame generation; the game itself runs at a fraction of it (60 on screen = 30 x2).

settings.label: AMD FSR Frame Generation
settings.help: 2x frame generation on any graphics card through AMD FSR SDK 2.4 (off while NVIDIA Frame Generation is on).

settings.label: NVIDIA Reflex
settings.help: Lower input delay on NVIDIA RTX cards.

settings.label: DualSense speaker
settings.help: Play the game's controller sound effects through the DualSense built-in speaker.

settings.label: Adaptive trigger strength
settings.help: DualSense adaptive trigger resistance and vibration in percent (0 = off, 100 = game default).

settings.label: Vibration strength
settings.help: Rumble strength in percent for Xbox, Switch Pro and generic controllers (DualSense keeps its own haptics).

settings.label: Right-stick tilt mode
settings.help: For non-gyro pads (Xbox/generic): hold View/Back to tilt with the right stick, or press once to toggle.

settings.label: Performance overlay
settings.help: F2 shows or hides it in game.

settings.label: Game language
settings.help: Follow Windows automatically or pick a console language.

looks.reason: The game runs in a second program (Build\RunHybrid\AstroBot.exe) started by AstroHybrid, so ReShade looks don't reach it.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: AstroHybrid and game logs to attach to a bug report.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: Your Astro Bot save data folder.

actions.label: Mods
actions.help: Drop replacement game files here without modifying your dump.

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Precompiled shaders and pipelines. Clear only if visuals look wrong after an update.
